note: Round 27 (Claude, 2026-10-03): the nanotech crafting tree (Robert: 'create a nanotech crafting tree'). Unlocked in the Nanoforge tab of the inventory (I) with nanite shards, at your swarm's tier; two nodes are secrets found by experimenting.

nodes.name: Filament Spinning
nodes.desc: Teach the swarm to climb a thread. You can spin nanoweave -- cloth the nanites live in -- and make cowls, capes, robes, gloves, pants, boots, under-armour and even a chest from it.

nodes.name: Lattice Plating
nodes.desc: The swarm holds metal in a lattice instead of a lump. Lattice plate: armour at a third of the weight.

nodes.name: Micro-circuitry
nodes.desc: Nanites laid down as circuits. Rings, bracelets, chokers, necklaces and toe rings can be made of circuit instead of metal -- and carry the swarm.

nodes.name: Self-repair
nodes.desc: Every nano piece you wear mends you a little, all the time (+0.25 health a second each).

nodes.name: Adaptive Skin
nodes.desc: Crafted and nano, together. A piece that is both -- made by hand, then given to the swarm at the bench -- carries its gifts a quarter stronger.

nodes.name: Catalysis
nodes.desc: The swarm steadies a mix while you work it. Every combination at the bench is likelier to take, and likelier to surprise you.

nodes.name: Resonance Tuning
nodes.desc: Tune what you make to your own frequency: the synergies of qi and stillness (Singing, Neural, Quiet Shell, Heartwood Calm) come out half again as strong.

nodes.name: Swarm Reservoir
nodes.desc: Nano pieces you wear hold a reservoir of the swarm: each one grows it 3% faster.

nodes.name: Phase Weave
nodes.desc: The swarm carries part of everything you wear. All your gear weighs a quarter less.

nodes.name: Neural Lace
nodes.desc: Found, not taught: lightning-glass and the swarm, together at the bench, showed you this. Nano jewellery quickens your hands (+1.5% attack speed a piece) and you can draw storm filament.

nodes.name: Swarm Shell
nodes.desc: Open a warden's core and let it spread: swarm-shell, the strongest armour the swarm can be.

nodes.name: Entropy Harvest
nodes.desc: Found by failing: the swarm learned to catch what a ruined mix throws off. Half of what a failure would cost comes back, and surprises come more often.

nodes.name: Singularity Forge
nodes.desc: Two pieces of the same kind become one: the bench folds a second piece's gifts into the first.
